components.css: .ds-issue { font-family: Lato, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #26352e); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d8e0da); } .ds-issue > summary { display: flex; position: relative; gap: 14px; align-items: flex-start; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; min-height: 44px; padding: 20px 46px 20px 28px; } .ds-issue > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-issue > summary::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 28px; top: 29px; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-right: 1.5px solid var(--muted, #5d6c63); border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--muted, #5d6c63); transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-issue[open] > summary::after { transform: rotate(225deg); top: 33px; } .ds-issue > summary:hover { background: #f8faf8; } .ds-issue > summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #356eaf); outline-offset: 4px; outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-issue-badge { color: var(--error, #9e3b2d); background: var(--error-tint, #faede9); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 4px; margin-top: 1px; min-width: 47px; text-align: center; } .ds-issue-title { display: block; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 700; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-issue-location { display: block; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--muted, #5d6c63); margin-top: 6px; } .ds-issue-content { padding: 0 28px 24px 89px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.65; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-issue-content p { margin: 0; max-width: 68ch; } .ds-issue-content h3 { font-size: 15px; margin: 20px 0 6px; } .ds-issue-field { display: block; font-size: 11px; color: var(--green, #275c42); margin-bottom: 14px; } @media (max-width: 740px) { .ds-issue > summary { padding: 18px 35px 18px 18px; gap: 10px; } .ds-issue > summary::after { right: 19px; } .ds-issue-content { padding: 0 20px 22px; } }

narrative.overview:
This system uses a pale mineral ground, white work surfaces, evergreen actions, and graphite text. It gives invoice findings a restrained, readable hierarchy.

These are implementation choices for the local preview, not confirmed user brand preferences. The working name is billcheck. Final branding remains undecided.

Checked now on 2026-11-01 against the stylesheet, markup, interaction code, and refreshed review captures. The implementation is the source for every recorded token.
keyCharacteristics: One self-hosted sans-serif family for headings, controls, and prose.
Flat surfaces with fine rules and restrained corner rounding.
Issue severity appears through words, icons, and color.
Native disclosures expose detail within a stable reading order.

rules.name: The State Meaning Rule
rules.body: Green identifies actions and passing results. Red identifies errors. Ochre identifies warnings. Visible words preserve these meanings without color.

rules.name: The One Text Voice Rule
rules.body: Lato carries headings, prose, and controls. Monospace identifies field names, diagnostic codes, and reported values.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Fine borders and changes in surface tone separate content. The current interface uses no shadows.

dos: Do retain visible keyboard focus and the existing minimum control height.
Do pair severity color with a written label and a distinct status icon.
Do keep correction prose readable while long file names and reported values wrap.
Do preserve self-hosted fonts and the reduced-motion override.
Do keep synthetic examples labeled and passing results qualified.
donts: Don't imply that a passing check guarantees portal acceptance.
Don't replace native disclosure or button semantics with decorative containers.
Don't apply the small reference-code size to general body copy.
Don't turn this preview's implementation choices into claims about the user's brand preferences.
